title: Rishi
desc: Rishi, a thief, happens to own a floppy disk incriminating a minister of murder. Things turn chaotic when his lookalike Velu is targeted by the minister for the footage.

title: Manaivi Oru Manickam
desc: Ravi, a young man, visits India despite his mother's insistence that his life is threatened by a vengeful snake. He comes to regret his decision when the snake possesses his wife.

title: Thai Maaman
desc: Meena refuses to marry Rasappan as he is uneducated and rustic. In order to win her heart, he decides to become a minister and achieve success.

title: Anbe Sivam
desc: When Nalla and Aras get stranded at the airport, Aras tries to keep away from the man with a deformity. However, while forcefully accompanying each other to Chennai, they form an unexpected bond.

title: Chokka Thangam
desc: After Muthu gets his sister married, he is caught in a fix when the groom's parents force him to marry their daughter. However, Muthu is in love with another woman, Pavazham.
